Partner with exchange, product and engineering leads to resolve architectural trade-offs, align priorities and deliver scalable platform solutions. Mentor engineers across experience levels, lead technical design discussions and raise engineering standards across teams. Participate in the on-call rotation, lead incident response for team-owned services and drive engineering improvements that prevent recurring incidents. Skills Significant experience in software, backend or platform engineering, with a track record of leading complex technical projects and delivering production software and scalable, cloud-native environments. Deep software development expertise, including the ability to independently design, build, test and deploy services or substantial tools from scratch and guide others through complex implementation decisions. Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience, including designing and operating production environments, troubleshooting complex failures, and establishing patterns for high availability and efficient scaling. Strong hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure as code using Terraform, including making architectural decisions across complex environments. High proficiency in Java and Python; Go is a plus. You should be comfortable bridging the gap between infrastructure and application logic. Deep understanding of distributed systems and the ability to make and explain trade-offs between low latency, high availability, scalability and operational complexity. Strong proficiency in using AI collaborators such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to ship production code and improve engineering workflows. Proven ability to turn ambiguous problems into a clear technical direction and deliver improvements across team boundaries, balancing immediate needs with long-term architectural health. Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions, influence without formal authority and collaborate effectively with distributed engineering and product teams. Experience mentoring senior engineers and building alignment around technical standards and architectural decisions. Preferred Qualifications Experience in high-growth startup environments. Background in designing and building internal developer platforms, tools, CLI applications or infrastructure automation services. Drive at least one foundational platform initiative from design through deployment. Establish yourself as the technical escalation point. Years 2-3: Define architectural direction for major platform capabilities that will serve us for 3+ years. Lead multi-quarter initiatives that fundamentally change how we build or how customers use our platform. Your impact is measured by what others can now accomplish. Why nTop Work on genuinely hard computational problems in geometry and high-performance computing with real impact in aerospace and advanced manufacturing. Shape the technical foundation of a platform defining a new category. Collaborate with deep specialists while having autonomy to solve problems your way.
